items.title: Dell Stock Shrugged Off the Nvidia Shipment Pause Reports and Jumped 6.7%
items.summary: Nvidia reportedly told Dell to hold shipments to four Asian countries, yet investors piled in anyway. One price level on Monday will reveal whether the market sees a brief hiccup or a lasting break in the AI buildout.

items.title: Dell Soars 14% in a Week, Nvidia Up 20%, as Jensen Huang Returns. Dell’s Record Quarter Wasn’t Why
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell shares rose 14% in a week, mostly in Monday’s AI hardware rally after Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO. Dell’s record third quarter came after the rally, and a margin warning from Hewlett Packard Enterprise took back part of the gain.

items.title: Supermicro’s $80 Billion Sales Ambition Could Change Its Stock Outlook
items.summary: Supermicro posted a record quarter and raised its outlook, yet shares tumbled anyway. A federal probe now hangs over a stock priced far below its rivals, and one question decides whether the growth ever gets rewarded.

items.title: Salesforce, Snowflake, Four Security Software Leaders Headline Barrage Of Tech Earnings
items.summary: Salesforce stock has come under selling pressure ahead of its upcoming report, but Docusign continues to hold up quite well pre-earnings.

items.title: UI's Enterprise Technology Sales Surge: Can UniFi Momentum Sustain?
items.summary: Ubiquiti's Enterprise Technology revenues surge 43.2% on strong UniFi demand, but rising component costs and supply constraints could threaten growth momentum.

items.title: Dell’s Operating Costs Fell to “the Lowest in Our Company’s 42-Year History.” The Stock Fell Anyway
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell’s revenue more than doubled to $54. 9 billion in its fiscal third quarter, and operating expenses fell to 7% of revenue, a record low.

items.title: DELL's AI Server Sales Surge: Can the Growth Momentum Continue?
items.summary: Dell's AI server revenues surge 291% to $22 billion, with a record $132.3 billion backlog and rising AI demand fueling growth prospects beyond fiscal 2027.
